cell_line.evidence: ALK phosphotyrosine interactome: Peptide pull-downs were performed on NB1 cell lysate from DMSO- and LDK378-treated cells with biotinylated peptides coupled to sepharose-streptavidin beads.

cell_type.evidence: Here, we performed quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics on neuroblastoma cells treated with one of three clinically relevant ALK TKIs (crizotinib, LDK378, or lorlatinib) or an experimentally used ALK TKI (TAE684) to unravel aberrant ALK signaling pathways.
inferred: ALK Interactome and phosphoproteome: For the interactome analysis, SILAC cells were lysed, ALK was immunoprecipitated in parallel for each condition (equal amounts), eluted and mixed.
